caption: The video showcases a close, top-down view of a shallow water surface over a dark brownish substrate. A web-like network of bright yellowish-white sunlight caustics covers it entirely. The network continuously morphs as bright lines bend, stretch, merge and split, while luminous nodes drift across the frame. Bright patches expand, contract and shift position, yet the layout of dark cells enclosed by bright lines is retained. A small cluster of dark plant-like shapes hangs at the top edge, shifting horizontally and partly moving out of and back into view. No separate object, animal or person enters the water. The motion stays confined to the deforming light pattern and the sway of edge vegetation.
